voice.speaker: Ryan
voice.instruct: Calm, clear and friendly, like a good teacher explaining an idea for the first time. Steady pace.

beats.s0b0: Here's a curve, f of x equals x squared, and one point on it.
beats.s0b1: The derivative at that point is the slope of the tangent line, the line that just grazes the curve.
beats.s0b2: At x equals one, the tangent rises two for every one across, so the slope is two.
beats.s1b0: Slide the point along the curve, and the tangent slides with it.
beats.s1b1: On the left the slope is negative. At the bottom the tangent is flat, so the slope is zero.
beats.s1b2: Then it tilts up again. The derivative is that slope, at every point.
